source_review.finding: The aligned non-quant shader loads activation vec4 values and specializes NUM_ROWS up to eight so one workgroup accumulates multiple output rows.

candidate.description: Own two adjacent output columns per local256 workgroup, reuse each BF16 activation value across two independent FP16 weight rows, preserve each column's original F32 FMA order and eight-wave reduction tree, and replace two completion updates with atomicAdd(counter, 2).

correctness.red: ImportError on the absent pair2 wrapper before implementation.
correctness.green: K6144/N3072 and K9216/N3072 production-shape fixtures match every projection, residual, and normalized BF16 byte against the retained fixed-K composite; both completion counters reset to zero.

leaf.protocol: 11 counterbalanced samples, five warmups, 20 launches/timing burst

decision.result: reject and remove before runtime integration
decision.reason: Halving workgroups does not reduce the dominant streamed F16 weight payload, while the second live accumulator/reduction raises VGPR allocation 24 to 32 and loses at both natural shapes.
decision.reopen_only_if: A new representation or vector transport reduces weight transactions without changing the exact per-column arithmetic tree.
